draft.briefing: Hey, you're at Chamundi Hills! Goddess Chamundeshwari's temple sits right on top, and on the road up there's a lookout where the whole white city of Mysuru spreads out below you. Down at the base is India's first sand sculpture museum.
draft.hungryLine: There's not much to eat right here at the hills, so grab a meal back in Mysuru city and carry water for the climb.

moodReplies.show-me-around: The Mysore Sand Sculpture Museum is just a 4 min walk away. Then head up the hill road to the Lookout View Point and on to the Chamundeshwari Temple at the top.
moodReplies.somewhere-to-chill: Stop at the Lookout View Point and take in Mysuru and the forest around it from above.
moodReplies.surprise-me: Every one of the 150 sculptures in the sand museum at the foot of the hill was made by a single artist, MN Gowri.

spots.name: Chamundeshwari Temple
spots.detail: At the top of the hill · Goddess Chamundi's temple with beautiful architecture

spots.name: Lookout View Point
spots.detail: On the road up the hill · Aerial view of the whole city

spots.name: Mysore Sand Sculpture Museum
spots.detail: 4 min walk · 150 sand sculptures of Mysuru's heritage, wildlife and religion

legends.title: Not a single drop
legends.body: Mahisasura had a boon that every drop of his spilt blood would become a new demon. So Goddess Chamundi got help from Tripura Sundari, who drank every drop before it hit the ground, and she still guards the town from the foothills.

tips.title: Take the steps in the cool hours.
tips.body: For the stairs, get off buses 203, 205 or 401A at JSS College and walk 800 m to the bottom of the steps.

tips.title: Or just ride up.
tips.body: AC bus 201 runs from the city bus stand to the hilltop every twenty minutes.

story.title: The goddess wins
story.body: Legend says Goddess Chamundi slew the demon Mahisasura with help from Tripura Sundari. Her temple crowns the hill that carries her name.

story.title: A royal zoo
story.body: Under royal patronage, the Mysore Zoo opened in the city below the hill. It's the oldest zoo in India and one of the oldest in the world.

story.title: Natural history
story.body: The Regional Museum of Natural History opened on the banks of Karanji Lake, with exhibits on the plants, animals and geology of South India.

story.title: Sand at the foothills
story.body: India's first sand sculpture museum opened on one acre at the base of Chamundi Hills. Artist MN Gowri made all 150 sculptures.
